review_scope: All 24 mechanically-neither cases triaged for their described source contract; not complete 64-fix semantic qualification. The 40 reverse-applicable cases remain mechanical evidence only.

checks.subject: arm64: user4k: keep 4K userspace off unless booted with user4k=on
checks.assessment: Runtime policy is still default-off via user4k_enabled(), early_param, exec selection and PRCTL validation. MM_SUBPAGE remains compiled in; boot-time opt-out is not absence of all shared MM changes.

checks.subject: Documentation: arm64: user4k: say the option is on by default
checks.assessment: Documentation distinguishes default-y build option from default-off runtime feature.

checks.subject: arm64: build mixed-granule userspace by default
checks.assessment: Kconfig still defaults ARM64_USER4K_EXPERIMENTAL=y and explicitly documents runtime opt-in. Resolved candidate enables this and MM_SUBPAGE.

checks.subject: perf/core: restore the speculation bound on AUX page lookups
checks.assessment: AUX lookup still applies array_index_nospec to pagenum against aux_nr_pages before indexing.

checks.subject: exec: drop the user page-size preference on privilege-gaining exec
checks.assessment: Preference-free secure_page_shift is recorded by arm64 exec and bprm_secure_page_size selects it on privilege-gaining exec. No new set-ID/runtime test here.

checks.subject: vfio/type1: compile out fragment provider paths without MM_SUBPAGE
checks.assessment: vfio_dma_has_fragments retains IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_MM_SUBPAGE) && dma->fragments; all nine fragment-use decision sites call it.

checks.subject: userfaultfd: keep the UFFDIO_COPY source check without user4k
checks.assessment: Old fs/userfaultfd.c moved to mm/userfaultfd.c. Exact reviewed source-check branch survives: current->mm byte range with MM_SUBPAGE, registered ctx->mm unaligned range otherwise. USERFAULTFD is disabled in the candidate.

checks.subject: io_uring/rsrc: limit the fragment-owner account skip to user4k
checks.assessment: headpage_already_acct is gone. Native compound-page accounting now uses hpage_acct_ref/unref and io_buffer_account_pin, while fragment accounting has separate CONFIG_MM_SUBPAGE implementation. The old one-line skip patch cannot certify this replacement accounting/lifetime model.

checks.subject: mm/vmscan: gate MGLRU legacy-memcg writeback change on subpage
checks.assessment: sort_folio no longer contains the old writeback branch and isolate_folio no longer contains the old reclaim-clear branch. This is a changed reclaim implementation, not proof of a missing two-line guard or equivalent behavior. Compare upstream base and stress legacy-memcg/writeback separately.

checks.subject: docs: index the new Apple documents and fix their title markup
checks.assessment: Some indexes/titles survive but apple-ave and the old/new PMP-DVFS paths are absent from the compared snapshot. Documentation relocation/removal remains to be traced. No J314S executable behavior inferred from this patch.

checks.subject: drm/apple: build the AFK service test only with the display driver
checks.assessment: AFK service test is under apple/Makefile reached through DRM_APPLE; parent Makefile no longer builds it unconditionally. Kconfig preserves DRM_APPLE || !DRM_APPLE tristate bound.

checks.subject: vfio/type1: make the retained-fragment KUnit tests depend on TMPFS
checks.assessment: Both arm64 VFIO harnesses retain TMPFS dependency. VFIO account tests now require MM_SUBPAGE and TMPFS outright: stricter applicability than old non-subpage test support, with the required mixed-granule guard retained.

checks.subject: usb: typec: tipd: put the debugfs command file behind a Kconfig option
checks.assessment: Debug command creation remains behind CONFIG_TYPEC_TPS6598X_DEBUG_COMMANDS; resolved candidate disables it. Read-only register interface is separate. No controller command was sent.

checks.subject: wifi: brcmfmac: drop the runtime AWDL interface_create parameters
checks.assessment: AWDL flags/index remain constants; awdl_bssid is charp mode0444, with no writable flags/index module parameters. No radio reconfiguration performed.

checks.subject: drm/asahi: reject unsupported command fields on the M1/M2 queue path
checks.assessment: Render and compute readers still use read_supported for bounded versioned structures; prior pinned-source GPU-reader controls passed. Header/reader inspection does not qualify actual GPU command behavior.

checks.subject: drm: apple: answer DPTX group 1 calls 3 and 4 on 13.5 firmware again
checks.assessment: dptxport_group_call retains 13.5 group1 command3/4 dispatch to the bounded reply helper; legacy12.3/13.5 otherwise dispatch by command. Native wire_v2 dispatch is explicitly separate. This is source compatibility for observed13.5, not HDMI audio acceptance.

checks.subject: drm: apple: relink a Type-C sink only when DCP drops it at link-up
checks.assessment: Reviewed eligibility, spinlocked state, retry/time bounds and IRQ_HPD behavior. Legacy direct Type-C relinks are bounded and tunnels excluded; native/H17P paths use separate lifecycle. Complete attach/unplug concurrency and all route effects still require subsystem/hardware review.

checks.subject: usb: typec: tipd: send each IRQ_HPD request to the display route once
checks.assessment: cd321x_dp_send still suppresses unchanged status, emits a new IRQ as SEND, and emits an edge for repeated coalesced pulses. Core routes pulse/edge separately and updates cached status after success. Actual partner IRQ timing remains untested.

checks.subject: tools/aurora-sep: tests: Let the T8112 SEP DMA harness build again
checks.assessment: T8112 host fixture contains fw_mirror and firmware mapping/handoff stubs, reordered and extended. This is fixture-source review; this particular harness was not executed in this continuation.

checks.subject: soc: apple: sep: Let suspend proceed when a capture is slow to stop
checks.assessment: Void PM event callback and sleep_prepare allow capture-stop timeout to continue suspend; Rust/C shim signatures agree. Actual suspend is deliberately deferred until basic boot and recovery pass.

checks.subject: soc: apple: sep: Initialise an empty host-state store file again
checks.assessment: Store::from_file initializes empty/all-zero files only for Size/Header damage; describe rejects oversized/nonzero content, and other invalid stores return refusal without writing. Generic StoreIo/memory fixture replaced old filesystem-only helper. No owner store was opened or modified.

checks.subject: soc: apple: sep: Do not autoload the driver through a module alias
checks.assessment: SEP OF_TABLE is a private IdArray rather than an exported module alias. Previously audited package/module boundary preserved; loader/owner policy still controls loading. No module was loaded.

checks.subject: spi: apple-qspi: keep the T8140 boot NOR read-only outside nvram
checks.assessment: T8140 nvram-window policy and apple_qspi_window_allowed gate remain; later driver adds more layout/transaction controls. Full write/erase policy equivalence not claimed. T8140-specific path does not qualify or need exercising on J314S; no NOR access performed.

checks.subject: pmdomain: apple: pmp-report: match T8140 report entries by compatible
checks.assessment: Entry OF table retains distinct apple,t8140-pmp-v2-report-entry matching. Old exact-hunk failure reflects surrounding table movement. T8140 entry matching is not proof of J314S PMP/energy behavior.

remaining: semantic qualification beyond mechanical evidence for the 40 reverse-applicable commits
attended J314S 7.2 boot, actual clients and .20 recovery
